_doc: kdd28_wide_datasets: wide (>=100 feature) binary sets (OpenML, plus Epsilon from its Hugging Face parquet) added to the KDD28 accuracy evaluation. Built by benchmarks/src/distributed_spo_gbt/rebuild_wide_data.py <folds_dir>; sha256 of raw/data/fold files in kdd28_wide_datasets_manifest.sha256. Validation evidence: ariel_notes/results/2026-11-04_wide_datasets/validation/REPORT.md (2026-11-04).
encoding: benchmarks/data/tabular_suite_prep.py: numeric -> float32, bool -> 0/1, categorical/string -> ordinal codes over sorted distinct values; label two classes -> majority 0, >2 classes majority-vs-rest. Only OpenML row-id/ID columns listed in drop_columns are removed; constant and duplicate columns are kept (CLAUDE.md: never drop rows or columns).
folds: run_suite.make_folds: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0) as kdd28_tabarena33 (fold seed 0; training seed 1 is separate). NaN kept in <data>/<name>/train_nan.csv; each fold imputes NaN with its training fold's column means (test reuses them, all-NaN -> 0.0).

datasets.name: epsilon
datasets.folds: shipped train/test split: one holdout fold (k=0), fold0_train = 400k train, fold0_test = 100k test
datasets.massage: none: 2000 numeric, no NaN, label 0/1 as shipped, CSV bytes as benchmarks/data/download_epsilon.py
datasets.source_note: LibSVM epsilon_normalized (PASCAL Large Scale Learning Challenge 2008) via the Hugging Face jxie/epsilon-normalized parquet conversion. The files the Vertex AI runs read: gs://ariel_ydf_bucket/big/EPSILON/{epsilon_normalized_train.csv, epsilon_test_100k.csv} (run_vertex_barriers.py:24). Never the OpenML Epsilon (data id 45575, train+test merged), user directive 2026-11-04

datasets.name: santander_transaction
datasets.massage: drop ID_code (row id string, 200000 distinct); target bool -> majority False = 0
datasets.source: Kaggle santander-customer-transaction-prediction train set (2019). OpenML name 'SantanderCustomerSatisfaction' is a misnomer: ID_code train_0.., var_0..var_199
datasets.license: OpenML 'Public'; Kaggle competition rules not verified

datasets.name: dota2
datasets.massage: 116 nominal {-1,0,1} -> ordinal codes over sorted strings ('-1'<'0'<'1' -> 0,1,2, order preserved); Cluster_ID (47) and Game_mode (9) ordinal; Hero_023 and Hero_107 constant, kept
datasets.source: UCI Dota2 Games Results (Tridgell 2016), train+test merged by OpenML uploader

datasets.name: hcdr_main
datasets.massage: drop SK_ID_CURR (OpenML row_id_attribute); 48 nominal (max 58 levels) -> ordinal; NaN (24.8% of cells, 67 cols) kept in train_nan.csv, train-fold mean per fold
datasets.source: Kaggle home-credit-default-risk (2018) application_train main table, as used by TabTransformer (Huang et al. 2020)
datasets.license: OpenML 'Public'; Kaggle competition rules not verified

datasets.name: christine
datasets.massage: 37 binary nominal -> ordinal 0/1; 25 constant + further duplicate columns kept (CLAUDE.md: never drop columns)

datasets.name: philippine
datasets.massage: none needed (all numeric, no NaN); 51 exact duplicate columns kept

datasets.name: guillermo
datasets.massage: none needed (all numeric, no NaN); 15 constant columns kept; 116 extra duplicate rows kept (0.8% of test rows have a train twin)

datasets.name: vehicle_sensIT
datasets.massage: none: 100 numeric, no NaN. OpenML already maps SensIT classes 1,2 -> positive, 3 -> negative, which is majority-vs-rest (class 3 = 49264 = classes 1+2). Label tie -1/1 -> '-1' = 0. 28 duplicate rows with conflicting labels kept
datasets.source: SensIT Vehicle (combined), Duarte and Hu, JPDC 64(7) 2004, via LibSVM (train+test merged by the OpenML uploader)

datasets.name: youtube8m
datasets.folds: shipped train/validate split: one holdout fold (k=0), fold0_train = 3.89M train, fold0_test = 1.11M validate
datasets.massage: none: 1152 numeric (rgb_0..1023, audio), no NaN, header class -> label, other bytes as shipped
datasets.label_rule: class = 1 iff the video's labels include label 0, the most frequent label (788288 of 3888919 train videos), majority-vs-rest
datasets.source_note: YouTube-8M video-level features as CSV, the files the Vertex AI runs read (run_single_anchor.sh YOUTUBE8M, label class). Added 2026-11-05 (user directive)
datasets.unbuilt_reason: dropped 2026-11-05 (user): ~6 days per run on r8i.96xlarge (13 min/tree single SPO), see paper note in tab:dist-accuracy-ydf-wide
